passes.name: source-definition-contract
invariants: Connector definitions remain sourcegen-ready or clearly explain the missing grammar feature.
Definitions declare verification, resource families, projection templates, coverage dimensions, and reference-only secrets.
required_evidence: review of any classifier output changes

passes.name: source-runtime-coverage
invariants: Runtime families have catalog coverage, fixture pairs, pagination/cursor safety, and projection registration.
Provider reads preserve source HTTP safety, bounded responses, and tenant-scoped event shape.

passes.name: compliance-policy-packet
invariants: Policy rules, control refs, control selections, posture, and evidence packets use one shared compliance contract.
Generated detection and policy catalogs are regenerated instead of hand-edited.

passes.name: agent-graph-control-plane
invariants: Agent-facing behavior starts from typed evidence packets, verifier results, tenant scope, and replayable events.
Graph Ask paths remain tenant-scoped, read-only, bounded, and citation-aware.
required_evidence: replay or trajectory evidence for agent-facing changes

passes.name: workflow-review-release
invariants: Review and release automation should expose precise context, avoid duplicate manual loops, and preserve public PR data safety.
Post-merge health surfaces release/tag skew without making normal release lag look like a failed merge.
